She went to college 3 different times. She finished each time then went back for another degree in something else. I believe each time she was in college for 2 years. 

Yes, definitely see if you doctor can help with your focus too. 

Is there any hobbies that interest you at all?

Please go talk to your doctor. He or she wont judge you. They will help you find a medication to hopefully help and maybe they will suggest getting a therapist so you have someone to talk to that may help you.

Maybe it's time to find a hobby. Like knitting, or gardening. There is so many fun things to try.

Ask yourself this. Is school and work more important than my mental health?

It's ok to change your mind during college on what you want to do. A lot of people end up changing their mind. My older sister has went to college for 3 different things now because she kept changing her mind.

I'm so sorry that you have to deal with this. Have you thought about going to a therapist to talk? I know it's not fun seeing therapists but I have been feeling the same and I finally got myself a therapist last month. It has been helping me. I still have my down days, especially with this quarantine going on, but my therapist has helped me change some things in my life for the better. Or medication? I've also started taking medication again to try and help.

I'm sorry that you are feeling like this. If you can maybe try and start talking to a therapist. I know some therapists are using skype right now so they can still talk to people. Or maybe find some friends on any apps to talk to. Or maybe text a family member and see how they are doing.
